### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**9** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/formula/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/formula/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **64** of **227** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **29** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 69244406b7e93b8856f3a5991ec18433a7e96dc4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4cc190191dc30f403527cb34bc25b93e0341eeae` — the merge of head `cc6ea750a12b616c7c77867e1d419b1c45059733` into base `69244406b7e93b8856f3a5991ec18433a7e96dc4`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh

git fetch origin 4cc190191dc30f403527cb34bc25b93e0341eeae && git checkout 4cc190191dc30f403527cb34bc25b93e0341eeae
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 69244406b7e93b8856f3a5991ec18433a7e96dc4 cc6ea750a12b616c7c77867e1d419b1c45059733 && git checkout -B drift-repro 69244406b7e93b8856f3a5991ec18433a7e96dc4 && git merge --no-ff cc6ea750a12b616c7c77867e1d419b1c45059733

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 69244406b7e93b8856f3a5991ec18433a7e96dc4
```

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cc6ea750a12b616c7c77867e1d419b1c45059733`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md + packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.ts, packages/formula/src/index.ts, packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts

Inputs read: card #31609 (body and all five comments: triage 6724150397, claim 6724336691, triage H14 6724444852, claim amendment 6724651755, `os-dev-report` 6724915226), PR #31631 body and file list (6 files), the net diff `133f75ae..cc6ea750` (merge-base with `origin/main`; `origin/main` at `69244406` has not moved the three touched source files or the ADR since the merge-base), and the check-runs on the head. The rest of the diff (`.changeset/31609-home-amount-arithmetic-formula.md`, `packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.test.ts`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT and is not reviewed here beyond what ② needs.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Face and tier — right.** `reviewFace` on the file list returns `hits` = the ADR alone (rules face). `docs/adr/**` is a Tier H register row, so the whole PR is Tier H: it is a draft with no auto-merge, and the PR body says landing waits for a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval. The seat's claim amendment 6724651755 ruled the anchor repoint rides this PR and ordered this review; the amendment is on the card.
- **Accept-set — unchanged, right.** No `packages/spec/**` path, no Zod schema, no authorable key, value or default moves. `CURRENCY_FRACTION_DIGITS` stays in `@objectstack/spec/data` and objectql still imports it from there. `Metadata-protocol: none` is the correct kind.
- **Public surface of `@objectstack/formula` — widened, right.** `packages/formula/src/index.ts` gains four value exports (`toScaledDecimal`, `divideToPlaces`, `formatScaledDecimal`, `documentDateOf`) and one type export (`ScaledDecimal`). Nothing is removed. A `git grep` of the head tree finds no earlier binding of any of these names in formula's index, so no clash. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and the changeset body is the right declaration.
- **Public surface of `@objectstack/objectql` — unchanged, right.** `packages/objectql/src/index.ts` exported none of the five names at the merge-base and exports none at the head (it exports only `HomeAmountReads`, `HomeAmountServing`, `ExchangeRateRow` types from the projection module). The re-export added to `home-amount-projection.ts` keeps an internal import site (`home-amount-recompute.ts` L116-120, `home-amount-projection.test.ts` L21) and publishes nothing new from the package. The objectql changeset entry is earned by its moved published source, not by a surface change.
- **Dependency graph — no new edge, right.** `packages/objectql/package.json` already lists `@objectstack/formula: workspace:*`, and eleven objectql `src/` files already import from `'@objectstack/formula'` at the merge-base. `packages/formula/package.json` dependencies are unchanged (`@marcbachmann/cel-js`, `@objectstack/spec`); the new module imports nothing at all. No cycle: formula does not depend on objectql.
- **Browser safety of formula — holds.** `ui/packages/core` and `ui/packages/app-shell` depend on `@objectstack/formula` (`workspace:^`), and `ExpressionProvider.tsx` imports it in browser code. The new module uses only `BigInt`, `RegExp`, `Date`, `Intl.DateTimeFormat` and `String` — no `node:` import, no Node global. A grep of `packages/formula/src` (tests excluded) for `node:`, `fs` or `path` imports finds none at the head.
- **Check-runs on the head as read at 2026-11-08T17:54Z (61 runs):** 31 `success`, 9 `skipped`, 0 `failure`, 21 `in_progress`. Green: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, the three scoped lints, `Type Check · source gates`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check PR Size`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `Build UI Deps`, `Live E2E UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Plan Test Core shards`, `Auto Label`, `filter`. Still running: `Build Core`, `Test Core (1-8/8)`, `Test UI (1-16/16)`, `Type Check UI`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Build & E2E UI`. The ADR anchor gate (`check:adr-symbol-anchors`) rides the lint families, all of which are green on this head. No conclusion read red.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/31609-home-amount-arithmetic-formula.md`: `@objectstack/formula: patch`, `@objectstack/objectql: patch`. Both line-initial declarations are present in the changeset body and in the PR body, byte-identical: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Level is right.** AGENTS.md Post-Task rule 3 and the level axis of `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (maintainer ruling A): the level follows the metadata-protocol kind alone; `none` grades every introduced entry `patch`, and "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`". A `feat(formula):` commit type may not lower a bump and does not raise one above what the kind allows. The dev's delta asked `minor`; `patch` is what the rule requires, so the shipped level is the correct one, not a compromise. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.
- Not `skip-changeset`: two released packages publish moved source. Right.
- No BREAKING banner, no ADR-0087 disposition owed: nothing an author or an importer could write is removed or renamed (objectql's package index never exported the four, and its internal module re-exports them).
- Clause-②: `yes (widening)` — matches the diff exactly (new exports on formula, nothing removed anywhere).

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 6724915226 (`os-dev-report`), four deviations and two open questions:

1. **ADR-0144 edited (+4/-2), governed, Tier H** — answered. The seat's claim amendment 6724651755 ruled the repoint rides this PR because `check:adr-symbol-anchors` cannot stay green across two PRs when a private symbol (`divideRoundHalfAwayFromZero`) moves. Verified in ④: the hunk is anchor-only. The PR is correctly left as a draft awaiting the maintainer's approval; this record does not lift Tier H.
2. **Changeset level `patch` where the delta said `minor`** — answered in ②: `patch` is what the rule requires under `Metadata-protocol: none`. No exception is owed or available.
3. **Two overlapping local gate sweeps, dts reds cleared by rebuilding six untouched packages** — a worktree-process matter with no footprint in the tree (the six packages are not in the diff). The head's check-runs are the gate verdicts of record; no local reading is adopted here.
4. **Harness attribution lines not used in commits** — the two non-merge commits (`f3715fe6`, `cc6ea750`) end with the model-free pair `Claude-Session:` + `Co-authored-by: Claude` that AGENTS.md's commit-message rule requires; the harness-written trailer is the rule's named exemption, not a requirement. Compliant; nothing to escalate.

Open questions:

- **Q1 — keep the engine names (`toScaledDecimal`, `divideToPlaces`, `formatScaledDecimal`, `documentDateOf`, `ScaledDecimal`) on `@objectstack/formula`?** Answered: **A, keep.** ADR-0144's anchors name these symbols; `home-amount-recompute.ts` and the projection test import them by these names; the card's step 3 says the ui imports them by name; a rename would force an alias layer in objectql's re-export with no reader gaining anything. No clash in formula's index.
- **Q2 — accept `patch` on formula?** Answered: **A, patch** — see ②.

No flag is escalated; none needs the maintainer beyond the Tier H approval the PR already waits on.

### ④ Design judgment

**The ADR hit, sentence by sentence.** Both hunks sit under `## Open items` (the dated settlement notes of items 2 and 3), not under any D1-D9 decision section; no decision text, status line, provenance or consequence changed.

- Line 387 (item 2, the document date): the only change is the backticked path, `packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts#documentDateOf` to `packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.ts#documentDateOf`. The clause "the zone rides the same settings bridge as the home currency, item 4" is untouched, and remains true: `documentDateOf` still takes the zone objectql reads through `serving.timezone` (projection L398, recompute L492). Anchor resolves: `documentDateOf` is declared at `packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.ts` L111 in the head tree.
- Lines 402-404 (item 3, arithmetic and rounding): the path swaps to `packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.ts`; the three symbol continuations `#divideToPlaces`, `#divideRoundHalfAwayFromZero`, `#toScaledDecimal` are unchanged and resolve at L81, L67 and L36 of the new file (the private one as a declaration site, which the gate accepts). The appended clause — "moved there unchanged from `packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts`, which imports them back, on 2026-11-08 in #31609, so the form's live home-amount preview reads the engine's one copy" — is provenance, true against the tree (byte-identity below; objectql imports them back at its L71), and adds a file-level anchor to the objectql module, which exists. It decides nothing; the sentence it extends (D7 parameter 3, exact BigInt arithmetic, one half-away rounding, the bare-number spelling) is unchanged.
- Every other ADR-0144 anchor into the objectql file (`#projectHomeAmounts` L346, L382, L407, L426, L448; `#memoizeHomeAmountServing` L382; `#HomeCurrencyUnsetError` L425, L468; `#ExchangeRateMissingError` L467; `#settleBulkHomeAmounts` L473) names a symbol still declared in `packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts` at the head (L204, L249, L296, L355, L424). The `scripts/adr-anchors/` JSON for `home-amount-recompute.ts` names no moved symbol. No other doc, ADR or `ui/` file in the head tree cites the moved symbols under the old path.
- First consumer: `projectHomeAmounts` (objectql L355-407) calls `toScaledDecimal`, `divideToPlaces`, `formatScaledDecimal`, `documentDateOf` at L369, L384, L398, L402, L406, L407 exactly as before, now through the import; `toStoredNumber` (the projection-only step) stays in objectql. The ADR's execution plan is unchanged (the record still "implements nothing").
- Nit: the appended clause cites the card number as provenance inside the ADR; AGENTS.md treats tracker numbers as convenience links, and these notes already cite PR #28302 the same way, so this is consistent with the record's existing style. No action.

**`packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.ts` — the move is byte-identical.** Read-only comparison with `git show` and `cmp` (no build, no run): merge-base objectql L141-213 (73 lines: `ScaledDecimal`, `DECIMAL_SPELLING`, `toScaledDecimal`, `abs`, `divideRoundHalfAwayFromZero`, `divideToPlaces`, `formatScaledDecimal`) equals new L21-93, sha256 `e2d14cd8…`; merge-base L225-269 (45 lines: the document-date heading, `CALENDAR_DATE`, `documentDateOf`, `calendarDayIn`) equals new L95-139, sha256 `bcd97179…`. Every line outside those two blocks is the licence line, a 15-line module docblock, the `Exact decimal arithmetic` section heading and blank lines; no function body is outside the moved set. The docblock carries the ADR id (`ADR-0144 D5, D7 parameter 3, Open items 2 and 3`), satisfying Prime Directive 13's "leave its id in the code". Its claim "has no dependency of its own" is true. Behaviour is identical by construction; the three unchanged objectql projection suites are the lane seat's evidence and are not re-run here.

**`packages/formula/src/index.ts`** — six added lines, a four-line comment naming ADR-0144 D5 and the two readers, then `export { toScaledDecimal, divideToPlaces, formatScaledDecimal, documentDateOf }` and `export type { ScaledDecimal }` from `./home-amount-arithmetic`. Placed after `inferFormulaReturn`, no other line touched. Nit: the comment says the form's live preview "reads this one copy" in the present tense while that consumer (#27196 PR 2) does not exist yet; the sentence states the purpose correctly and will be true on that PR. No action.

**`packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts`** — +8/-120. Added: a four-line comment, `import { documentDateOf, divideToPlaces, formatScaledDecimal, toScaledDecimal, type ScaledDecimal } from '@objectstack/formula'`, `export { … }` of the four values and `export type { ScaledDecimal }`. Removed: exactly the two blocks above plus their two trailing blank lines. `toStoredNumber`, `homeAmountsTouched`, `planHomeAmounts`, `projectHomeAmounts`, `memoizeHomeAmountServing`, the two error classes and `settleBulkHomeAmounts` are untouched; the module's 60-line header still describes the arithmetic correctly (it states behaviour, not location). The re-export keeps both internal import sites and the projection test's import site working without edit. Nit: the `// ── Exact decimal arithmetic ──` section heading remains above only `toStoredNumber`; cosmetic.

**Anything moved that the card did not name?** No. The diff touches six files; the private helpers that moved (`DECIMAL_SPELLING`, `abs`, `divideRoundHalfAwayFromZero`, `CALENDAR_DATE`, `calendarDayIn`) are the "private helpers" step 1 of the card names with the four functions; `CURRENCY_FRACTION_DIGITS` stays in spec as step 4 requires; `toStoredNumber` stays in objectql as a projection-only step.

**Attempts to break it, all held:** a dependency cycle (none: formula depends on spec and cel-js only); a Node-only import reaching the browser through formula (none in the new module or anywhere in formula `src/`); a lost objectql export (objectql's package index never exported the four, before or after); a stale anchor elsewhere (none: every other anchor into the objectql module names a symbol that stays; no other file cites the old path for the moved symbols); a changed body (byte-identical by `cmp`); a semver mis-grade (patch is the rule's grade under `none`); an unresolved anchor in the head tree (all four resolve by declaration site, and the lint families carrying the anchor gate are green on the head).

Findings: must-fix 0; should-fix 0; nit 3 (ADR provenance cites the card number, index comment's present tense, orphaned section heading in objectql). None affects correctness or the contract.
